methodology.scope: Real model APIs on isolated, public synthetic catalogue pages; not Glovo or a broad unseen-site benchmark.
methodology.planning: Pipeline uses natural-language goals and a real OpenRouter planner, concurrently with initial navigation; same planner in both arms.
methodology.guidance: Fixed public semantic task isolates Jev versus OpenRouter DOM versus OpenRouter DOM plus screenshot. No answer URL or ID enters the policy.
methodology.comparison: Stepwise is the SAME new executor with extra 700 ms nonterminal waits; it is not the old deployed Glovo baseline.
methodology.timing: Total includes navigation, planning, runtime, journals and independent verification; browser/context setup and final result write excluded and recorded separately.
methodology.cost: OpenRouter reported account charge plus estimated Jev tokens at $0.042/M input, zero output. Separate BYOK fields retained if present; infrastructure excluded.
methodology.limits: 25 scheduled task attempts, six model calls/$0.01 per attempt; stop before further attempts on unknown usage/cost or $0.10 known batch cost.
